The generic command runner has no such problem — it runs the suite and reads the exit code. The cost is that there is no per-test coverage analysis, so every mutant reruns whatever the command runs. Hence `scripts/stryker-module.mjs`, which narrows the command to one module's own test file and turns a campaign into a minute rather than an afternoon.
